results.title: Outsider Employees’ Union Allegedly Occupies Bhopal Municipal Corporation Property, Breaks Locks To Set Up Office
results.description: A BMC property near Kamla Park in Bhopal has allegedly been occupied by an outsider employees’ union, which reportedly replaced the civic body’s locks and converted the premises into an office. After two notices to vacate went unanswered, BMC officials are preparing to remove the belongings and reclaim the property.
